Reid Bikes Explorer S 20" | Kids' bike
A fun and dependable 20" kids' bike designed for young riders, combining a lightweight steel frame, BMX-style handlebars and easy-to-use braking for everyday adventures and building riding confidence.
The Reid Bikes Explorer S 20" is designed for children aged 6 and over who are ready to build their confidence and enjoy greater independence on two wheels. With a lightweight steel frame and BMX-style handlebars, it offers a straightforward, easy-to-handle ride for exploring the neighbourhood, riding with family and enjoying time outdoors.
The 20" wheels are fitted with wide 2.4" BMX-style tyres, providing a stable ride for everyday cycling. A front V-brake and rear coaster brake offer two simple braking options, helping young riders manage their speed and come to a controlled stop.
The single-speed drivetrain keeps things simple, with a 36T chainset and 16T freewheel providing straightforward pedalling without the need to change gears. Junior BMX-style grips, a junior-specific saddle and plastic pedals complete the setup, while the full-length chainguard helps protect clothing and keeps little hands away from the chain.
Built with practical features and a durable design, the Reid Bikes Explorer S 20" is a great choice for young cyclists ready for their next riding adventure.
The Reid Bikes Explorer S 20" is ideal for:

Young riders aged 6+, with a 20" wheel size suited to growing cyclists

Building riding confidence, with front V-brakes and a rear coaster brake

Simple, easy riding, with a straightforward single-speed drivetrain

Everyday adventures, with a lightweight steel frame and BMX-style handlebars

Stable handling, with wide 20 x 2.4" BMX-style tyres

A comfortable fit for younger cyclists, with junior-specific saddle and grips

Keeping clothes clean and protected, with a full-length chainguard
